changelog: Full screen for a running session; Esc or the top edge leaves it
Always allow chosen devices without asking, per device and with their own permissions
A Screen drawing setting that picks OpenGL on older display drivers, against blinking
Error and status notices close by themselves after a few seconds
An Update button in the sidebar whenever a new version is ready
Zoom stays where you put it instead of changing by itself
A session survives Run as administrator prompts
A small red dot you can drag anywhere replaces the screen edge glow
Send several files or whole folders, download folders, and see pictures as thumbnails
